fields.objective: Current objective value in arbitrary practice units

transformations: Rows are sorted by algorithm and iteration for rendering only; source values are not changed.
Historical best is the cumulative minimum of objective within each algorithm.
Stepwise update is objective[t] - objective[t-1] within each algorithm; negative values indicate improvement under minimization.
Net change is objective at iteration 10 minus objective at iteration 1; endpoint values remain in the original practice-unit scale.
provenance.uncertainty: No replicate runs, seeds, or error estimates are provided; no uncertainty band, interval, or statistical test is shown.
unsupported_claims: causal explanation for the trajectory shapes
